facts.text: The brochure is one page.
The module is version 1.2.112 and runs on Daggerheart.
You are an Ultimate.
An Ultimate has Leg, Body, Hand, Eye, Shadow and Head.
keywords: Leg, Body, Hand, Eye, Shadow, Head

facts.text: You start with Health 4, Sanity 6 and Hope 2 (max 6).
Sanity at zero is a Breakdown.
A Breakdown gives disadvantage on every roll.
Health at zero is Wounded.
Wounded means one action fewer.
Rolls with Hope give you 1 Hope.
keywords: Rolls with Hope give you 1 Hope

facts.text: Rolls with Despair feed Monokuma.
A critical gives 2 Hope.
Each time of day gives you 2 actions and 1 Free Move.
They refill when the Eclipse before the next time of day begins.
keywords: They refill when the Eclipse before the next time of day begins

facts.text: Moving inside your room is free.
keywords: Moving inside your room is free

facts.text: The first crossing into a connected room is your Free Move.
keywords: The first crossing into a connected room is your Free Move

facts.text: Every further crossing costs 1 action.
Drag your token to move.
The cost lands when you arrive.
keywords: the cost lands when you arrive

facts.text: Locked doors, sealed rooms, other people's bedrooms (no key) and Chained turn you back.
keywords: Locked doors, sealed rooms, other people's bedrooms (no key) and Chained

facts.text: Chained is a Despair Call that keeps you in your room until the time of day ends.
keywords: a Despair Call that keeps you in your room until the time of day ends

facts.text: The Eclipse comes before each time of day.
In the Eclipse the lights are out.
In the Eclipse nobody sees anybody.
In the Eclipse nobody hears anybody.
In the Eclipse you place your token up to 2 connected rooms away.
Before Night you may place your token in any room.
You see only your room.
You see only the people in your room.
Visited rooms are veiled.
The rest of the rooms are fog.
With regional voice on, your voice follows your token.
keywords: With regional voice on, your voice follows your token

facts.text: With regional voice on, you hear only your room.
Every room has Search Tokens.
A room usually has 3 Search Tokens.
Search Tokens are shared by everybody.
During the Eclipse nothing spends an action but a Direct Murder.
keywords: nothing spends an action but a Direct Murder

facts.text: During the Eclipse there are no Calls.
Search is rolled with Eye, or another statistic the GM approves.
keywords: Eye, or another the GM approves

facts.text: With Search, name what you want.
Search difficulties are 8+ Tier 0, 12+ Tier 1 and 18+ Tier 2.
A critical on Search gives +1 tier.
Search spends a search token.
Taking a weapon with Search leaves a trace.
keywords: Taking a weapon or a cleaning tool leaves a trace

facts.text: Taking a cleaning tool with Search leaves a trace.
keywords: Taking a weapon or a cleaning tool leaves a trace

facts.text: Observe is rolled with Eye.
Observe copies a Remnant into your inventory as a Neutral Truth Bullet.
keywords: Copies a Remnant into your inventory as a Neutral Truth Bullet

facts.text: A missed Observe costs 1 Sanity.
Analyze is rolled with Head.
Analyze can identify a Truth Bullet.
A missed identification locks the Truth Bullet until the chapter ends.
keywords: a miss locks it until the chapter ends

facts.text: Analyze can ask the GM for a hint at 14+ or 18+.
keywords: ask the GM for a hint (14+ / 18+)

facts.text: Analyze can Find Stash at 16+.
Analyze can Find Passage at 16+.
A project is rolled with the project's own statistic.
A project roll of 12+ gives +1 progress.
A project roll of 18+ gives +2 progress.
A critical on a project gives +2 progress.
A critical on a project gives the action back.
Propose new projects to the GM.
keywords: Propose new ones to the GM

facts.text: Sabotage lives under Projects.
Sabotage always leaves a trace.
For a Dynamic action you propose and the GM sets the roll.
Describe anything in a Dynamic action.
The GM sets the difficulty of a Dynamic action.
Dynamic actions have gentler thresholds.
Gentler thresholds are the reward for inventing something.
Facilities need no roll, or use the row's roll.
Short Rest costs 1 action, you pick 1, and it is once per time of day.
keywords: Short Rest: 1 action, pick 1, once per time of day

facts.text: Long Rest costs 2 actions, you pick 2, and it is once per session.
keywords: Long Rest: 2 actions, pick 2, once per session

facts.text: Sleep restores Health.
Meal restores Sanity.
Breath restores Hope.
The rests work only in rooms marked for them.
keywords: the rests only in rooms marked for them

facts.text: Below the rests, Facilities lists what the room you stand in offers.
keywords: what the room you stand in offers

facts.text: Infiltrate is rolled with Shadow, Leg, Body or Hand.
Infiltrate offers Listen, Echoes, Tail Someone, Dash, Shut the Door, Force the Door, Pick the Lock and Keep Watch.
Listen at 14+ tells how many are next door.
Listen at 18+ tells who is next door.
A critical on Listen covers every adjacent room.
Rooms you have not been in stay unnamed: Unexplored room 1, 2...
keywords: rooms you have not been in stay unnamed: Unexplored room 1, 2...

facts.text: Dash gives 2 free crossings at 12+, 3 at 18+ and 4 on a critical.
Palm is rolled with Hand + Shadow.
Palm can take something from somebody's pocket at 12+, or unseen 15+.
Palm can plant something in somebody's pocket at 8+, or unseen 13+.
Palm can also see what somebody carries.
To see what they carry you ask first.
After a refusal, seeing what they carry is Body 12+.
Unseen, seeing what they carry is Shadow 15+ then Hand 10+.
Tamper is rolled with Shadow.
Tamper can erase a Trace you know of in this room.
keywords: Erase a Trace you know of in this room

facts.text: Erasing a Trace ranges from Hidden 9 to Obvious 18.
Tamper can reshape a Trace at 3 lower.
The GM approves the new words of a reshaped Trace.
keywords: the GM approves the new words

facts.text: Tamper can plant a Misleading Trail at 15.
Tamper costs an action.
Tamper costs no Sanity.
With no action left, you cannot Tamper.
keywords: with no action left, no Tamper

facts.text: Witnesses mean a cover roll (16).
The cover roll can cost Sanity even when it works.
keywords: can cost Sanity even when it works

facts.text: The Sanity cost is 1 on Despair and 1-2 if you are caught.
keywords: 1 on Despair, 1-2 if you are caught

facts.text: Direct Murder is rolled by the GM.
Direct Murder is possible only during an Eclipse.
Direct Murder must be agreed with the GM.
Direct Murder needs the victim's player's consent.
Direct Murder is judged when the lights come up.
keywords: Judged when the lights come up

facts.text: When the lights come up you must be alone with exactly one other person.
keywords: alone with exactly one other person

facts.text: You can hold 3 usables.

keywords: Murder Weapons, Cleaning Tools and Tools

facts.text: Only one of the things sharing the gear slots can be stowed.
A tool that is not held ready does not count.
keywords: hold a tool ready or it does not count

facts.text: Truth Bullets and keys are unlimited.
keywords: Truth Bullets and keys are unlimited

facts.text: Despair on a roll wears the tool you used by 1 point.
keywords: Despair on a roll wears the tool you used by 1 point

Broken things stay in your pocket until you stash or throw them away.
keywords: Broken things stay in your pocket until you stash or throw them away

Your bedroom is locked to others without a key.
keywords: Your bedroom is locked to others without a key

keywords: a key opens it for whoever holds it, even a stolen one

Everybody sees the card.
Cancel sends nothing.

facts.text: Leave a Clue is 12.
Secure a Trace is 15.
Self-Defense is 18.
Self-Defense unlocks Survive and Role Reversal.
Use an Item is 15.
Every turn after your first costs Sanity, then Health.

keywords: Everyone gets the Autopsy Truth Bullet

Three to five Key Remnants exist.
Together the Key Remnants narrow the suspects to 2-4.
You can take what the body carries from its sheet.

facts.text: Taking from the body costs no action.

keywords: the price is not given back

facts.text: Then comes 60 s of only you.

keywords: a Panic Round has no Objection
